scope: Primary-documentation comparison; no account created, subscription bought or live authenticated quote captured.

providers.initial_signup_phone: No phone field in public signup form and served form module
providers.quote_clock: One NBBO-message timestamp; not independent side-event timestamps

providers.plan: AlgoTrader Plus; real OPRA options and consolidated SIP stock data
providers.initial_signup_phone: Official paper-only documentation describes email-only registration; no brokerage account opening is required for paper signup
providers.paid_entitlement_phone: unverified; stop if a phone field is required
providers.quote_clock: One RFC3339 nanosecond NBBO-message timestamp, actual prices and sizes; no separate side clocks
providers.free_feed: Modified indicative options; not admissible as actual OPRA quotes

providers.paid_entitlement_phone: unverified; published OPRA terms alone do not prove signup fields

decision: Prepare ThetaData local-terminal capture for existing account owners, plus Alpaca as the lowest-priced documented single-provider OPRA/SIP package among these candidates. Theta is cheaper options-only; its Free plan is historical EOD. Neither paid phone-free onboarding nor live entitlement is verified.
cost_limits: Published monthly retail prices before tax and any unverified subscriber charges; not an exhaustive market minimum or spending authorization. A mixed Theta/free-stock route could cost less but is unqualified.
integration: Data capture and current-account-bound admission diagnostics only. No financial migration, automatic collection, durable execution or strategy promotion.
